cas_docs: Quick heads-up - ran into mixed terminology in the migration guide. Some samples say `model`, others `modelVersion`, and a handful still show `model-family`. We should standardize and add a short "cheat sheet".
priya_eng: agreed. Backend accepts `model` as canonical param. `modelVersion` is okay in prose if we mean a concrete version. `model-family` is a product-level concept.
mark_pm: can we capture that as three glossary rows? e.g., `model family` = family id, `model` = callable id, `model version` = explicit build tag.
nina_ux: +1. Also: UI uses Title Case for labels; docs prose should be sentence case. Add a note so screenshots and copy match.
cas_docs: plan: 1) add glossary entries 2) patch migration/params.md with a compat table 3) sweep examples and SDK snippets. I can pick up docs/ and examples/.
priya_eng: I'll handle sdk-snippets/ and generated examples. I will also leave comments where the API layer accepts both names to avoid breaking customers.
mark_pm: small tone question: contractions allowed in tutorials but keep API reference formal. Nina, can you file a tiny UX note on when to be conversational so docs folks can reference it?
nina_ux: filing note now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/229 - will add examples.
build-bot: grep results: 29 hits in docs/, 4 in examples/, 6 in sdk-snippets/ -> https://ci/reports/param-variants-2125801023
cas_docs: thanks. I'll open a PR that updates glossary.md and adds a cheatsheet snippet showing the same request in curl / python / js:

curl: curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-latest"}'
python: client.generate(model="rwd-latest")
js: client.generate({ model: "rwd-latest" })

priya_eng: perfect. Also add a Compat note: "Accepted legacy names: `modelVersion`, `model-family` for X months; recommend `model`."
cas_docs: timeline? hoping to bundle in docs deploy tomorrow.
mark_pm: fine as long as PRs are linked to tracking issue 229.
cas_docs: will do. tagging reviewers in PR description to speed merge.
priya_eng: I'll run snippet-tests after my changes. build-bot, queue snippet-runner when PR is open.
build-bot: snippet-runner scheduled for 2125801400 when PRs linked to issue 229 are found.
cas_docs: thanks team, small docs cleanup should make onboarding smoother. Ping here when your PRs are up. :sparkles:
